.floating-cta { position: fixed; bottom: var(--space-xl); left: var(--space-xl); width: 56px; height: 56px; background: var(--burgundy-700); border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: var(--white); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); z-index: 100; transition: var(--transition-base); opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); }
@keyframes fadeInUp { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
@keyframes dot-pulse { 0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; } 50% { transform: scale(1.3); opacity: 0.7; } }
.hero__eyebrow { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--burgundy-600); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.15em; margin-bottom: var(--space-lg); }

.hero__passport { width: 280px; height: 400px; background: var(--burgundy-800); border-radius: 8px; padding: var(--space-md); box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl); transform: rotate(-5deg); transition: var(--transition-slow); }
.hero__stamp { position: absolute; top: 20%; left: 10%; width: 120px; height: 120px; transform: rotate(15deg); opacity: 0.7; animation: stamp-float 6s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes stamp-float { 0%, 100% { transform: rotate(15deg) translateY(0); } 50% { transform: rotate(18deg) translateY(-10px); } }

.hero__scroll-indicator { position: absolute; bottom: var(--space-2xl); left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-sm); color: var(--gray-500); font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; }
@keyframes scroll-line { 0%, 100% { transform: scaleY(1); opacity: 1; } 50% { transform: scaleY(0.5); opacity: 0.5; } }
.problem__date-label { display: block; font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: var(--gold-light); margin-bottom: var(--space-md); }

.solution__partners-title { font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.15em; color: var(--gold-light); margin-bottom: var(--space-xl); }
.comparison__th { background: var(--gray-800); color: var(--white); font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }
.course__detail-label { font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: var(--gray-500); margin-bottom: var(--space-xs); }

.pricing__card-badge { position: absolute; top: 0; right: var(--space-xl); transform: translateY(-50%); background: var(--gold); color: var(--burgundy-900); padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-lg); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; }
.pricing__card-label { font-size: 0.875rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; opacity: 0.8; margin-bottom: var(--space-md); }
.urgency__block-label { font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: var(--gray-500); margin-bottom: var(--space-xs); }
.register__form { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-lg); }
.register__submit:hover { background: var(--burgundy-900); box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 var(--gold); transform: translate(3px, -3px); }

.register__visual-box { width: 200px; height: 260px; background: var(--burgundy-700); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transform: rotate(5deg); box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl); border: 4px solid var(--gold); transition: var(--transition-slow); }
.footer__partners-label { display: block; font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.15em; color: var(--gray-500); margin-bottom: var(--space-lg); }
.reveal { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(30px); transition: opacity 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), transform 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); }

.modal { background: var(--white); max-width: 600px; width: 100%; max-height: 90vh; overflow-y: auto; position: relative; transform: translateY(20px) scale(0.95); transition: var(--transition-base); }
